chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Musa ibn al-Qasim ibn Mu'awiyah al-Bajali, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام.
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
Say: Have you considered, if your water were to sink away, then who would bring you flowing water?
He عليه السلام said: When your Imam is absent from you, then who will come to you with a new Imam?

key_terms.إِمَامُكُمْ: your Imam, the divinely appointed guide
key_terms.غَوْرًا: sunken away or vanished from reach
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: the divine statement of Allah, Mighty and Majestic
key_terms.مَاؤُكُمْ: your water; interpreted here as a metaphor for access to divine guidance

ai.seo_question: How do Shia hadith explain Qur'an 67:30 in relation to the ghaybah of the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith interprets the Qur'anic image of inaccessible water as a reference to the ghaybah of the Imam عليه السلام. It emphasizes that the Imam is a divinely given source of guidance, and that no one can independently produce or appoint a new Imam when the Imam is absent.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Musa Bin Al Qasim Bin Muawiya Al Bajaly, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his brother<sup>asws</sup> Musa<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[67:30] Say: Have you considered if your water should recede, who is it then that will bring you flowing water?
. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When your Imam<sup>asws</sup> is absent from you all, so who would come to you with a new Imam<sup>asws</sup>?’.
en.sarwar: 14. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Musa ibn al-Qasim ibn Mu‘awiya al-Bajali from Ali ibn Ja’far from his brother, Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s.)
who has said the following about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious.
“Say, “Have you not thought that if your water was to dry up, who would bring you water from the spring?” [67:30].
The Imam (a.s.) said, “When your Imam would disappear from your sight then who will bring for you a new Imam?”
